PluginData.Author: RougeSable
PluginData.Tooltip: Cel shading in three styles: Comic book, Animated film and Clear line.
PluginData.Description: Sir Cel Shading gives the game a cel-shaded look, in the style of the player's choice. Clear line (the default): thin even outlines, bright plain colors, almost no shadows. Animated film: shadows in two or three soft tones, thin outlines in a darker shade of each object, a rim of light on silhouettes seen against the sun, and distant things fading into the sky. Comic book: black outlines and flat colors. The player picks the style and turns the effect on or off at will, in the plugin settings or with /cel in the chat (/cel comic, /cel animated, /cel clearline, /cel status), without restarting the game. Everything happens on the player's machine: a player without the plugin sees the game's own rendering.
